restaurant_name: บ้านแสนสุข รักษาสัตว์
text:
We've used their services several times.
We had our cat spayed elsewhere, and when we saw this nearby clinic, we decided to come in for wound cleaning and stitch removal.
The procedure cost 50 baht.
We come for cat and dog rabies vaccinations, so we keep our appointments fairly often.
Deworming medication costs 40 baht, and the doctor administers oral medication.
Rabies vaccinations cost 80 baht per shot.
Combination vaccinations cost 250 baht per shot.
Blood and kidney tests cost 400 baht.
We've inquired about spaying and neutering.
The cost is around 1,200-1,300 baht, including post-surgery equipment and medication.
Anti-licking suits are 100 baht each.
I think the price is in the middle range, not too expensive and not too cheap.

The place looks clean and tidy.
The service is good. The doctor is very caring and loves animals. He talks to you to relax, massages you, and scratches you to make you feel comfortable. He seems to have good skills in dealing with animals.

Overall, I like it and recommend using their services.

They have free Wi-Fi to use while you wait. The code is on the wall of the waiting area. There's parking behind the shop.
The entrance is next to the coffee shop.

text: We've been to many places in Chiang Mai, but this one is unlike any other. The care here is incredibly friendly. Dr. Nun explains things carefully, provides attentive care, and has excellent service mind. The prices are also reasonable. There are many veterinary hospitals, clinics, and animal treatment shops in Chiang Mai, but we're confident this one is different. P.S. We have no affiliation with the clinic; we're just a customer who wanted to share and review a great pet treatment shop in Chiang Mai.
